exam.title: Red Hat Certified System Administrator in OpenShift
exam.study_prerequisites: Red Hat recommends RHCSA-level administration, DO180 or equivalent OpenShift workload skills, DO280 or equivalent cluster-administration experience, and container familiarity. The live page currently mixes 4.22 and 4.18 and says multiple versions are in use; confirm the LMS assignment and practice every objective against that exact OpenShift version.

review.notes: The nine unweighted EX280 task groups were reconciled with the live page and both official 4.18 and 4.22 documentation baselines. The page's internal 4.22 headline/4.18 delivery conflict and explicit multi-version LMS assignment are preserved rather than flattened. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 40 original checks cover console/CLI evidence, images and troubleshooting, clean manifests and Kustomize, Deployments/templates/Helm/configuration, HTPasswd/RBAC, packet paths/routes/TLS/NetworkPolicy/L4 exposure, quotas/limits/project templates, Operator lifecycle, service accounts/SCCs/secrets/Jobs/CronJobs and reproducible replay. All 12 URLs are cataloged: ten reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Older content has an explicit assigned-version gap checklist and no recalled exam tasks are used.

findings.title: Conflicting exam delivery version remains
findings.evidence: Headline and matching PDF list identify 4.22; the main delivery paragraph still names 4.18, while multiple versions are in use.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Assigned version needs an explicit public reference
findings.evidence: Version PDF contains EX280V422 and older lists with different scope. The V422 list matches the main 55 tasks after normalization.
findings.recommendation: Link the public document, retain the exact assigned-version rule, and map only the current public V422 list.
findings.resolution: Link the public document, retain the exact assigned-version rule, and map only the current public V422 list.

findings.title: Multiple active versions does not establish a scheduled future change
findings.evidence: No future effective date is supplied by the multi-version statement.
findings.recommendation: Change upcoming metadata to none-announced and preserve the observed ambiguity separately; retain accepted source snapshots.
findings.resolution: Change upcoming metadata to none-announced and preserve the observed ambiguity separately; retain accepted source snapshots.

findings.title: Declarative guidance lacked a concrete replayable artifact
findings.evidence: Existing guide described base/overlay behavior without manifests or expected generated references.
findings.recommendation: Add original base, overlay and config change fixture; execute local rendering and check desired resource relationships.
findings.resolution: Add original base, overlay and config change fixture; execute local rendering and check desired resource relationships.

findings.title: Configuration update behavior needed consumption-specific boundaries
findings.evidence: Environment, normal volume and subPath consumers refresh differently.
findings.recommendation: Explain each case and distinguish generated-name rollout from editing same-name data.
findings.resolution: Explain each case and distinguish generated-name rollout from editing same-name data.

findings.title: Additive policies and selector indentation needed negative examples
findings.evidence: Combined selectors restrict the same peer; separate peers broaden alternatives; other selecting policies may widen access.
findings.recommendation: Add an original YAML fixture and allow/deny matrix with limited reference checks, explicitly not CNI validation.
findings.resolution: Add an original YAML fixture and allow/deny matrix with limited reference checks, explicitly not CNI validation.

findings.title: SCC access cannot be established from one authorization command
findings.evidence: RBAC checks omit direct SCC users/groups; describe omits RBAC grants, and namespace scope differs.
findings.recommendation: Trace both grant paths, workload context and admission result; prefer dedicated account and scoped use grant.
findings.resolution: Trace both grant paths, workload context and admission result; prefer dedicated account and scoped use grant.

findings.title: Classic OLM chain was stated without version qualification
findings.evidence: OLM v1 uses ClusterExtension and ClusterCatalog; classic console inventory does not show them.
findings.recommendation: Qualify classic instructions and add the current alternative resource model without expanding formal objective counts.
findings.resolution: Qualify classic instructions and add the current alternative resource model without expanding formal objective counts.

findings.title: Forty questions lacked answers
findings.evidence: Original knowledge-check section contained questions only.
findings.recommendation: Add reasoned answers to all 40 and distinguish actual local checks from eight proposed cluster labs.
findings.resolution: Add reasoned answers to all 40 and distinguish actual local checks from eight proposed cluster labs.
